key.name: island-style
key.description: "attached" hangs the island from the top bar like a notch; "floating" is a pill below it.

key.name: island-monitor
key.description: "primary" keeps the island on the primary monitor; "focused" moves it to the monitor of the focused window.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Expand the island while the pointer rests on it.

key.name: replace-clock-menu
key.description: Hovering or clicking the clock in the top bar opens the Nexsland panel (Notifications, Calendar) instead of GNOME's notifications and calendar menu.

key.name: show-on-lock-screen
key.description: Keep activities and HUDs visible while the screen is locked. The panel and its tabs never open on the lock screen.

key.name: show-when-idle
key.description: Keep a small pill visible when no activity is active.

key.name: vertical-offset
key.description: Distance between the bottom of the top bar and the floating island, in pixels.

key.name: animation-style
key.description: Spring preset used when the island morphs.

key.name: enable-media
key.description: Show media from MPRIS players as a live activity.

key.name: enable-osd
key.description: Show volume, microphone and brightness changes in the island instead of the stock OSD.

key.name: enable-battery
key.description: Show charging, unplugged, full and low-battery notices in the island.

key.name: enable-bluetooth
key.description: Show Bluetooth devices connecting and disconnecting.

key.name: enable-network
key.description: Show Wi-Fi, wired and VPN connections and disconnections.

key.name: enable-dnd
key.description: Show Do Not Disturb being turned on and off.

key.name: enable-banners
key.description: Show notification banners in the island instead of GNOME's own banners.

key.name: enable-recording
key.description: Show a running screen recording with its elapsed time and a stop button.

key.name: enable-privacy
key.description: Show which apps are recording from the microphone.

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: A panel tab listing the shell's notifications, with Do Not Disturb and Clear.

key.name: enable-timer
key.description: Countdown timer tab, shown as a live activity while it runs.

key.name: enable-calendar
key.description: Today's date and a month grid.

key.name: enable-stats
key.description: CPU, memory and network throughput, read only while the tab is open.

key.name: enable-clipboard
key.description: Recent text copies kept in memory only. Off by default for privacy.

key.name: enable-downloads
key.description: Show browser downloads in progress in the Downloads folder, and when they finish.

key.name: enable-nextile
key.description: Show NexTile tiling changes and add a Tiling tab. Needs External control turned on in NexTile.

key.name: enable-bar
key.description: Style the top bar, menus, dash and shell with the Bar module (continued from Open Bar). Off by default so installing Nexsland does not restyle the shell.

key.name: island-follow-bar
key.description: While the Bar module is on, draw the island with the bar's background, text and border colours instead of black.

key.name: log-level
key.description: 0 off, 1 error, 2 warn, 3 info, 4 debug.
